layout:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: actual top-down game level background for a Sega Mega Drive shooter, opaque 4:3 map. Image 1 is ONLY the church identity/material reference; it has the WRONG low camera, cramped layout and excessive texture. Image 2 is the actual character sprites and is the CAMERA AND PIXEL SCALE reference. Do not include characters in the output.
Primary request: redraw the church rear courtyard from a TRUE orthographic camera 60 DEGREES ABOVE THE GROUND, matching the character. Strong overhead view: see the roofs and broad ground plane; wall front faces shallow/foreshortened, NOT an eye-level church facade. North stays at the top, no horizon, no perspective convergence, no diamond/isometric rotation. Output aspect ratio4:3, meant to downsample once to512x384 native pixels.
Exact composition in logical512x384 coordinates: modest intact chapel confined to x16..200,y0..104; its terracotta roof is a broad overhead surface and its white plaster front/blue doors a SHORT band below the roof. Main facade foot at y104. Blue wooden evacuation gate and low north wall across x208..495,y48..104. Two SMALL clearly bounded prop groups at the top edge only: wooden bench plus three blue water jugs at x40..88,y104..120; folded blankets on two crates x288..328,y104..120. A red cloth tied to the upper-right open gate and a few faint boot prints toward it. All objects physically inside the upper band. No side annex extending into the yard. Low side walls only within x0..15 and x496..511. Bottom wall a very shallow narrow border ONLY y368..383, with a small gate aligned at x240..272. Outside tiny caatinga plants attached to the exterior edge.
CRITICAL: a broad uninterrupted mostly EMPTY earthen combat floor spans x16..495,y128..367, with no props, plants, obstacles, stairs or rubble anywhere in this region, including the bottom half. That walkable region is the main image subject, at least65 percent of canvas. Surface is ochre packed earth, very quiet, subtle sparse marks, low contrast; don't fill with broken stone or grunge. Architecture near top and boundary walls only. Environmental storytelling via the distinct top-edge belongings, evacuation gate, empty niche, blankets.
Style: crisp professional 16-bit GAME PIXEL ART at512x384 logical resolution with SINGLE-PIXEL fine edges, legible shapes, clean controlled clusters. No giant blocky pixel filter, no prescaling to256x192, no photoreal texture/noise, no antialiasing. Modular repetitive roof/wall patterns, restrained16-color palette: deep desaturated navy outlines, blue wood and water jugs, cream plaster, terracotta roof, olive plants, midvalue ochre earth. Aim simple economical repeatable tiles, broad flat shading, sharp detailed architecture, calm floor. No text, HUD, humans, enemies, border outside the map, or extra prop-study panels.
cameraCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the target game map. Correct ONLY the architecture/prop projection to a much STEEPER overhead camera, exactly60 degrees above horizontal ground. The current chapel facade is still too tall/front-facing. Redraw the chapel so we see MOSTLY the large roof top and only a narrow foreshortened wall face. Roof should occupy about70 percent of its total visual footprint, wall/door band only30 percent. Roof ridge horizontally across the upper-left, with broad visible terracotta roof planes. The side gate posts/low walls and top-facing bench/crates must follow the SAME steep60-degree orthographic camera. No horizon, no vanishing point, don't rotate the map into a diamond. Keep church footprint at top-left and front ground contact at logical y104 of384. The church's visible facade height should be no more than24 pixels at512x384 logical resolution. Keep the same white chapel, blue doors, bell gable/cross, terracotta roof, empty niche and evacuation belongings. Preserve the broad empty ochre play area, blue evacuation gate, lower gate and thin perimeter. Keep every obstacle confined to the top120 logical pixels or outer16-pixel border. Make the church slightly smaller if necessary to meet the projection and floor-space requirement. Fine crisp SINGLE-PIXEL16-bit art, no coarse pixel filter or blur. This is game scenery drawn to match top-down character sprites, not a low-angle church illustration.4:3 opaque canvas, no people, text or HUD.
damage: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only a SMALL localized section of the chapel's terracotta roof and right side wall in the UPPER LEFT of this game map. It is the alternate state after Damião's defensive bomb. About one quarter of the chapel roof is broken, with a few exposed rafters and a pale fractured plaster edge; keep most roof, the cross/bell gable, blue main doors and main silhouette standing. Small rubble confined WITHIN THE ORIGINAL chapel footprint, not spilling into the playable yard. Keep EXACT same steep60-degree overhead orthographic projection, canvas4:3, native-scale single-pixel style, lighting, color palette, church scale/position. Preserve ALL floor, lower border, gate, props, walls and vegetation outside the chapel pixel-for-pixel as much as possible. Do not add fire, smoke, people, blood or any new objects outside the church. No text, no HUD, opaque canvas.
export: game/tools/pack_courtyard.py; one native downsample, 16 hardware colors, modular tilemap assembly, exact deduplication without approximate tile substitution
